title: Ariadne: PAR evaluation artifact for "Purpose-Driven Associative Retrieval"

creators.name: Chen, Siyu
creators.affiliation: Chongqing Electric Power College, Chongqing, China

description:
Evaluation artifact for the preprint Purpose-Driven Associative Retrieval: Building a User-Modeling Context from a Memory Graph (v0.5, 2026-11-19).

Contents. dba_pipeline/ contains the PAR mechanism (typed jump axis, purpose scoring with a threshold, peak-tolerance band). eval/ contains the evaluation scripts, judge rubric and prompts, and the archived statistics and judge scores. data/dba_eval/ contains the 163-node memory graph, 26 dialogue batches, the 76-query set, and the L/M/H, perturbation, and automatic-graph variants. docs/paper/latex/ contains the LaTeX source and figures of the paper, and docs/theory/ contains the companion technical report on graph construction and maintenance.

Reproduction. See eval/README.md for the environment, the data dictionary, and the command for each experiment (E1-E15c). Complete context blocks and embedding caches are not archived; they are regenerated by the listed commands.

Licensing. Code is released under AGPL-3.0. The datasets in data/dba_eval/ and the judge prompts and rubric in eval/ are additionally available under CC BY 4.0.

Scope. The archived statistics support the negative result reported in the paper: at the default purpose-filter threshold of 0.30 no candidate is removed on the main graph, and the observed effect comes from purpose seeding and weighting rather than filtering.
